edit.description: `DOCUMENTED_HOOK_EVENTS` (:1689) is the allowlist `hookDefaultContract`'s one clause ranges over, and its own doc names the ritual: "the update ritual when the docs add an event is to re-fetch and extend this set, never to re-derive from memory". The set has not been walked since its 2026-07-15 retrieval and the page has grown: its 30 names are the page's list in the page's order with three missing. Re-fetch code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, extend the array to the page's event list in the page's order, and re-date the cite on both the const's doc-comment and the clause's `cite` field. A required-severity clause over a stale allowlist fires on a harness registering a documented event — the false positive `specs/intent.md` invariant 2 names as how a gate gets disabled.

The embedded built-in lock carries the clause's `values` (the `hook.enum.event` row, :302). Regenerated by re-running the memberless emit its own header describes — never hand-edited; `tests/builtin_lock_frozen.rs` drives the live SDK emit through the engine reader and is the proof the row was derived rather than transcribed.

The test that fails on the pre-fix tree: a settings.json registering one of the newly-documented events is read as a hook member and raises no `hook.enum.event` finding (today it raises one). Rides the module's existing vacuity idiom — assert `coverage.checked` names `hook (N)` for the members judged before asserting the silence, the shape `the_hook_default_contract_passes_documented_events` (:154) already uses. `the_embedded_builtin_lock_carries_the_hook_kind_and_its_event_clause` (:224) reads the regenerated `values` and needs no change; `the_hook_default_contract_fires_on_an_undocumented_event` (:128) uses `NotARealEvent` and stays true.

summary: A required clause ranges over a stale allowlist: `DOCUMENTED_HOOK_EVENTS` is three events behind the docs it cites, so a harness registering one gets a forged finding.

tests.asserts: a settings.json registering a newly-documented hook event is read as a member (the coverage.checked vacuity pin) and raises no hook.enum.event finding

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the regenerated `src/builtin_lock.toml` (`builtin_lock_frozen` passing) and the new hook_kind pin, plus `pnpm --dir sdk test` green.
notes: Walked against the page this tick (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, retrieved 2026-09-25, two independent reads): the page documents 33 events, the array 30 — the same names in the same order, missing `DirectoryAdded` (after `CwdChanged`) and `PreModelSwitch`/`PostModelSwitch` (after `PostCompact`). Encode the page's list at encode time, never this note. If the fetch is unavailable, leave the entry and say so rather than encoding from memory. scoped at 16f9f66f
